PRODUCER PRICE INDEXES - AUGUST 2026
The Producer Price Index for final demand rose 0.4 percent in August,
seasonally adjusted. Prices for final demand increased 5.4 percent over the
12 months ended in August. Final demand less foods, energy, and trade services
rose 0.3 percent in August. Earlier monthly estimates have been revised.
